notes.title: Into the Swamp | New Zone Coming Soon!
notes.content:
The Swamp zone is almost ready, and it will go live on Steam very soon. Here is what you can look forward to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/48b0bfe8a5ba0f4c189a8d7acebcdf5163f1ceba.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Enemy Types[/h2]
The Swamp introduces Multi-life enemies, creatures that attack in swarms and survive through multiple health bars. Every encounter will feel more dangerous than before. Some examples of Multi-life enemies are the Rabid Rats and Buzzing Swarm.

You will also face brand new bosses with unique mechanics. Expect:

[list]
[*] 10 new enemy types
[*] 12 new elites
[*] 3 powerful main bosses
[/list]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/d2b58e478a585dc3969fed8a7be28992652489fb.jpg[/img]

[b]Curse Cards[/b]: If left unplayed, they will punish you when reshuffled back into your deck.

[b]Sacred Relic[/b]: Each run begins with 5 charges. At certain Crossroads you can spend charges to gain powerful rewards or avoid dangers. You must always keep at least 1 charge in order to reach the final battle.

[h2]Visual Variety[/h2]
The Swamp offers two distinct maps and two unique Crossroads locations, giving each run its own atmosphere.

[h2]New Crossroads Events[/h2]
Fresh events linked to the new relic system add more decisions, risks, and rewards to every run.

Development is in full swing, and while some surprises remain hidden, more details will be revealed soon.

Release Date: October 6, 2025

See you in the Swamp!

notes.title: The Pistol Udpate
notes.content:
[h1]The Pistol - New Main Hand Weapon[/h1]

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]

The Pistol is the first new mainhand weapon we’re releasing since the Sword. The Pistol operates with the following mechanics.


[h3]Ammo[/h3]

Each pistol comes with a certain amount of ammo slots. Playing a Shot card consumes one ammo, and once you’ve run out, a Reload card will be added to your hand. The Reload card will stay in your hand until you play it, even after you end your turn. Playing the Reload card replenishes your ammo, and you can play Shot cards once again.


[h3]Shot Cards[/h3]

Shot cards are the Pistol’s attack cards. Every Shot also has a Gripstrike mode, which you can access by switching grips.


[h3]Pistol Switch[/h3]

Once you enter battle with a Pistol equipped, you will find its control element in the bottom left, in place of the Sword’s Heroic Strike. The Pistol icon shows which mode is currently active. The battle starts with the default, normal grip, which is used to play Shot cards. If you click the icon, the barrel grip will become active, and all of your Shot cards will turn over to become Gripstrikes. Toggling between the two modes doesn’t cost any resources and you can do it as often as you want.


[h3]Gripstrike[/h3]

Some shots will have a Gripstrike keyword in their descriptions; these cards will do something special in Gripstrike mode. The rest of the Shots’ Gripstrike mode will default to an 8 (for starter cards) or 10 (non-starter cards) damage melee attack.


[h3]Modification[/h3]

When you play a Modification card, you’ll be able to choose a Shot card from your hand to improve for the rest of the battle.


[h3]Bomb[/h3]

Each Pistol also comes with a set number of Bombs. Bombs stun the target and deal 5 damage to them. The number of bombs you start your battles with will increase as you progress in the run.


[h3]Mark[/h3]

Mark is a new keyword we’re introducing alongside the Pistol; Marking an enemy applies Vulnerability 3 to them. Further attacks to Marked enemies apply an additional Vulnerability 2 to them. Mark cannot be stacked.


[h3]Short-ranged[/h3]

Short-ranged cards can target enemies in the first three positions.


[h2]Pistol Variants[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/f95f43dd1400dd2d8485bffd0553fb79569087b3.png[/img]

[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/b999bcdd20c073207dff75f28faf3528ddfe20ea.png[/img]

The Pistol comes with 48 new cards, along with the earlier mentioned Reload and Gripstrike.

[h2]Pistol Boons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/25492f45638407879dbb43b5139c7de2bc4f3f77.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reach Master of Dueller Pistol level 5
[*] Reach Master of Service Pistol level 5

[*] Max out all your Pistol Masteries
[*] Obtain all Dueller Pistols
[*] Obtain all Service Pistols
[*] Obtain all Rifled Pistols
[*] Complete a victorious battle using only Gripstrikes
[*] Mark every single enemy in a victorious battle
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]Damage Preview[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/958aa9324c02eb9281a98159ba848836350368a7.png[/img]

Attack cards now show a damage preview when they are selected and you hover over targetable enemies. The values on the preview are calculated for the hovered enemy. AOE attacks will display a damage preview next to every affected enemy’s health bar. The values are (in descending order) the damage you will deal, the crit chance you have against that specific enemy, and then finally the damage you deal if you manage to land a critical hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/37bc3faf56ad46d6d69df065f62af7061691b04f.png[/img]

We have also simplified the card design by moving the range and type indicators above the description box for a simpler look and shorter texts.

notes.title: Build 0.360 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Inventory and Mastery Visual Changes[/h3]

The graphics in the inventory and mastery panels have been upgraded to reduce visual clutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/bcc6bdeb6e783f40155a14fa72125af159c509c3.png[/img]

notes.title: The Dagger Update
notes.content:
Build 0.350 for Monastery is now available! This update introduces Dagger variants, various visual upgrades, bug fixes, and improvements. Check out the details in the release notes below.
On behalf of the teams at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and for providing valuable feedback to help us improve the game!

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Combo[/b]: Playing a card generates 1 Combo. Combo resets at the start of your turn. Cards that consume combo don't generate any.
[*][b]Finishing Move[/b]: At the end of the turn a Finishing move is performed to the direction the player is facing.
[*][b]Momentum[/b]: Every card played earlier in the turn grants a card using this mechanic a bonus.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Daggers[/h3]

[b]Ballock Knife[/b]: Finishing Move deals 1 damage for every 4 Combo. Begin each battle in Stealth and with +1 Stamina.

Build 0.389 of Monastery is now available! This update introduces a map overhaul, various visual upgrades and some other improvements, along with bug fixes. On behalf of the team at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and providing valuable feedback!

notes.title: Development Update: Map Overhaul & Optimization Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We'd like to share some important updates regarding the development of the game.

[h2]Map overhaul[/h2]
We're currently hard at work on the visual and functional overhaul of the map. One of the most exciting changes is that bosses will now be selectable by area. We've managed to address several bugs, and the testing of these fixes is currently underway. Thank you for your patience and for consistently reporting bugs!

Last but not least, a new weapon, the dagger, is in the works, which will come with 40+ cards, new equipment, upgrades, and boons. We’re also further refining the loot system to give you even more options for character development.

notes.title: The Medium Armor Update
notes.content:
Build 0.349 for Monastery is now available! This update introduces medium armor variants, various visual upgrades, bug fixes, and improvements. Check out the details in the release notes below.
On behalf of the teams at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and for providing valuable feedback to help us improve the game!

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Medium Armor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Thickened Brigandine
[*] Hardened Brigandine
[*] Sable Brigandine
[*] Red Leather Armor
[*] Black Leather Armor
[*] Grey Leather Armor
[*] Hide Armor of the Night
[*] Hide Armor of the North
[*] Hide Armor of the Wild
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e338cf74b4cd4dad1a98c85336d0d79333592ffc.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Cards[/h3]

28 new cards have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/1d92b24a5819e7f2b697b65711b0a84a02901bd3.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Boons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Petal
[*] Wood
[*] Dirt
[*] Footstep
[*] Rain
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/143a5bce36e9b7d4923bcd31d54b5cc5ac5ac9a4.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]Brew[/h3]

Gain a random Potion card, or upgrade an existing one if you have any.
[olist]
[*] If you don't have a Potion in your hand, you receive a random Potion I.
[*] If you have Potion I in your hand, it upgrades to Potion II (same type).
[*] If you have Potion II in your hand, it upgrades to Potion III (same type).
[*] If you have Potion III in your hand, you receive a different type of Potion I.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] You will receive a Potion you don't already have if possible. If you have all types, you get a random one.
[*] Potions are retained in your hand between turns.
[*] If your hand is full, you lose the chance to get a Potion.
[*] Potions are single use and not part of the deck.
[/list]
[h3]Step[/h3]

Move through the first enemy on the chosen side. That enemy shifts to the first position on the other side.

[h3]Stealth[/h3]

Your melee single target attacks can target any unit and ignore Taunt. You can't have Armor while in Stealth. Stacking Stealth will grant your next single target attack +2 damage.

[h3]Poison[/h3]

Poison deals 1 damage per stack at the start of turn. There is a 50% chance of Poison stacks doubling at the start of every turn.

[h2]Visual and Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Ghoul and Wolf Elite Color Variations[/h3]

Elite Ghouls and Wolves now have distinct color variations, making them visually distinguishable based on their abilities.

[h3]Raider Bonus Shard[/h3]

When fighting Raiders, you receive a bloodshard reward based on the battle they appeared in. This bloodshard reward is granted immediately, regardless of how far you progress or if the run is successful.

[h3]Difficulty-Based Extra Shard[/h3]

At the end of a run, you receive an extra shard based on the difficulty level.

[h3]Trinket Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trinkets now have item requirements. You can only equip them if you also have the required item.
[*] Trinket tags have been updated and trinkets now have different mastery requirements
[*][b] IMPORTANT:[/b] If you previously purchased a trinket that has a different mastery requirement now, it will appear as locked in your inventory. You will be able to use that trinket when you reach the said mastery requirement.
[/list]
[h3]Redesigned Crossroads Visuals[/h3]

Redesigned crossroads have been added to all areas. Additionally, the routes of the crossroads will change slightly during the run to add visual variety.

[h2]General Improvements and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated protection action icon above enemies.
[*] Titan ability now has an icon indicating it gains thorns.
[*] Stealth stance now has a stacking icon, showing the bonus damage under the player.
[*] Extra action effect icon above enemies grays out if the player is immune to that effect.
[*] Enemy action icon grays out if it would apply an effect the player is immune to.
[*] Card drag can now be interrupted with the ESC key.
[*] Scry popup changes if you can no longer scry in that turn.
[*] HP values for Brigand and Rogue enemies have been adjusted.
[*] Shield throw now selects a new target if the first one is not damaged.
[*] Guard stance now allows power application.
[*] Burden boon now affects Leak, increasing its value.
[*] Game speed display updated to 1x, 2x, and 3x.
[*] Berserker stance bug fixed where crit chance increase was not removed properly.
[*] Automaton action now updates correctly when an enemy switches sides.
[*] Hydra Prototype Zero now has the Swift ability, indicating its attack cannot be blocked.
[*] Inventory category expansion added, and the selected item's category will be expanded upon entry.
[*] Enemy action icon above the head is now hoverable.
[*] Fixed Adaptation reward on Crossroads giving random item upgrade instead
[*] Chapel event options 1 and 2 now give stamina and focus upgrades that last until the end of the run
[*] Barricade enemy now has the Stable ability.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game may freeze during the enemy's turn and not switch back to the player's turn, only resolved by ending the hunt.
[*] The game may freeze upon winning the last round with the shield throw card, which first takes out a non-boss and then the boss.
[*] Cards may get stuck during excessive brewing.
[/list]

We continuously seek out and fix bugs, and we appreciate your reports! Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the new update.

notes.title: The Mines Update - Build 0.347 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Our team is delighted to announce that a major update, The Mines, is now out and available!
[/h3]

But what exactly does this mean for you, heroes of the Monastery?
The Mines is a menacing new area that provides way to the Monastery, but it does not make survival easier. It is just as dangerous as it seems!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e143dc75a8b380829733ca62e31f5d6d7e65e09d.png[/img]
The enemies found in the depths of the Mines are stronger than those you've encountered before. Fittingly to the theme, they are machines and their operators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e4733fd3b2f9be237917526c172f4de15af61386.png[/img]
These new enemies are going to be working together to take you down, buffing each other along the way by Charging and Loading each other, causing explosions, Shocking the player, and much more. Along with various the common enemies, the update contains 3 new bosses, as well 9 new elites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/234c54d95130fa142054fadd648dc6feae58a594.png[/img]
A new mechanic is also present in the update: the Mines-exclusive Scrap system. Scrap can be collected from fallen machines and can either be played as cards in battle, or used as currency at the Crossroads; you'll be able to trade your scrap for various rewards or passive buffs as part of the many new events you can encounter after every battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/b52488ad302b60b4c374cb0684f7a323e7afff1f.png[/img]

This is only the beginning of what we have in store, so stay tuned!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new area has been added to the game: the Mines, complete with new visuals in both battle and the Crossroads
[*] A new enemy type has been added to the game: machines
[*] 15 new Crossroads events
[*] Scrap system; gain Scrap after defeating fallen machines and play them as cards or spend them as currency at the Crossroads
[*] New visual effects
[*] New status effect icons
[*] 9 new tracks to accompany the player in the Mines
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Crossroads has been updated with more feedback panels that display what the player got as rewards
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the Pack event effect not working
[*] Fixed the Shelter event option 1 giving torches when it shouldn't have
[*] Fixed path discovery at the Crossroads when player only had 1 Torch 
[/list]
